key.description: The route-cache fresh read only runs with an object cache (request-context.ts gates routeCacheFill on objectCacheEnabled); without one the fix reduces to a 30 s TTL.
Tests set routeCacheFill directly, so they cannot catch K1.
Hard expiry instead of stale-while-revalidate, unlike the redirect cache: blocking refresh and outage sensitivity.
Widget areas have the identical delete-then-reinsert race, and the Cloudflare templates seed widgets (concurrent creation of the same widget area also throws on the unique name).
Not atomic on the Durable Object SQL backend (no batch or transaction); the changeset's atomicity claim is false there.
The overlap test pauses the first apply before its batch, so the delete/insert interleaving that matters is never driven; nothing exercises the Durable Object SQL path.
The reported 409 from POST /schema/collections is unchanged for unmarked orphans; the PR says so but still claims to close the issue.
Rows already stored under a locale code become unreachable after upgrade; "no migration needed" is false (borderline blocker).
String-only configs change case behaviour, undocumented.
Re-seeding duplicates rows stored under a locale code (en-US now resolves to en, the lookup misses the old row and inserts a second); same missing repair step as K6.
Presets or fractional/out-of-range quality make the Cloudflare image endpoint serve full-size originals (borderline blocker).
Quality is ignored in most render paths and leaks onto .
Conflicts with the existing meta.caption; the per-use override is ignored by sites reading meta.caption.
Generated site types (emdash-env.d.ts) omit caption.
Edit asset overwrites the per-use caption the PR claims to protect.
Seed and export paths skip or mishandle caption.
Media-usage discovery (content-fields.ts around lines 132-136) has the same storage-less title/name bug the PR fixes elsewhere.
A draft translation with taxonomies rewrites the published source's group-level terms; the cache purge was removed; the PR's "no public page" claim is false.
A code comment references an issue number, against the AGENTS.md comment rule.
The changeset omits comments from what the change covers.

cases.notes: A non-blocking note that Node/core endpoints lack cancellation is only partly valid: the core asset route always streams.

knownFalseClaims: Awaiting the folded reads can mask the root error: false at this head, every cold-start read catches and swallows its error, so the await cannot reject.
cases.notes: A changeset wording nit is fair and not penalised.
